read_me_first: A narrow market, calm on the surface but with single stocks moving very differently underneath. Leading scenario: DOLLAR_SQUEEZE. Two stories fit the tape about equally. 1 sector currently disagree with that story, 1 agree.

crown.headline: A narrow market, calm on the surface but with single stocks moving very differently underneath.
because: A handful of big names are carrying the index — the average stock is falling behind. This has been going on long enough to look tired. Breadth is near the bottom of its 12-month range, which is usually where it turns.

Single stocks are much more volatile than the index, and the gap is still growing. It widened by 2.6 points over the last month and is now wider than 81% of readings in the past two years. Gaps this wide and still growing have come before index falls of 5 to 7 percent. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 16.1, lower than 70% of the past two years.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and 3 of those positions are stretched. Crowded trades unwind quickly, so the size guidance is cut.
Big speculators are unusually long gold, copper, the Nasdaq and 5 others; unusually short natural gas (CFTC data to 2026-09-22).

Together, that is a fragile setup, not a confident one: a lot of money is already leaning the same way, so a break past the levels below would force that SAME money to reverse fast, accelerating whatever move already started rather than fading it.
No warning signs are lit — price and everything behind it agree.
crown.so_what: Buy cheap index downside. Small size — this one is tactical and time-sensitive. Size at 0.50x your normal risk (cut because the trend is crowded).
watch_for: If the 2-year trades above 103.32 (1.6% away), trend funds start buying.
If the dollar trades below 99.41 (1.9% away), trend funds start selling.
Watch for the average stock keeping pace with the index again. That ends the leadership trade and starts the breadth trade.
caveats: No dealer-positioning read today, so nothing above accounts for option hedging flows.
crown.note: Written from the numbers on this page every time it runs. When the data changes, this changes with it.

scenario.reading: DOLLAR_SQUEEZE leads but DISPERSION_REGIME is within 12%. Two stories fit the same tape; treat the overlap as the honest read, not the winner.
scenario.note: A score is the SHARE OF CONDITIONS MET, not a probability. Nothing here was fitted or backtested and no base rate was measured. The evidence and the missing-conditions lists carry the value; the number only ranks them.

scenarios.story: The dollar is the whole story and it is draining everything else — commodities, credit and non-US risk together.
scenarios.expression: US large-cap domestic over international and commodities.

scenarios.story: A stock-picker's tape. Implied correlation collapses and single-stock vol pulls away from a calm index — the index tells you almost nothing about what the average name is doing.
scenarios.expression: Single-name selection over index exposure. Pairs. Sell index vol / own single-stock vol.

scenarios.story: Growth decelerating. Credit widens, small caps break, and duration bids as a hedge rather than as a rate call.
scenarios.expression: Defensives, quality, long duration. Fade cyclical strength.

scenarios.story: Commodity-led repricing. Rates and the dollar rise together, which is the combination that hurts everything at once.
scenarios.expression: Real assets, energy, short duration. Multiple compression risk.

scenarios.story: Growth accelerating and yields rising with it. Cyclicals and small caps lead; duration is the funding source.
scenarios.expression: Cyclicals, financials, small caps, energy. Short duration.

scenarios.story: Flight to quality. The dollar and gold bid together while credit gives way, and CORRELATION rises — everything trades as one thing, which is what makes it a liquidity event rather than a rotation.
scenarios.expression: Cut gross. Defined-risk downside. Cash is a position.

scenarios.story: Yields fall without credit breaking. The benign version of lower rates — the one where breadth improves rather than hides.
scenarios.expression: Long duration equity, small caps, breadth trades.
